scope: Exact frozen six-source subscription initiative admission correction and existing installation plan. No runtime/native semantic trial or broader autonomy claim.

findings.finding: Subscription predicate requires exact existing Codex subscription endpoint and matching tenant/installation resource scope. It neither reads/refreshes credentials nor grants another endpoint; normal request admission, access lease/provider errors and bounded measured usage remain required.

Only the current verified owner private initiative-review source with exact durable event payload, operation identity, thread prefix/revision, WILL_MODEL_STARTED active phase and unexpired deadline receives subscription review admission. Current mandate/revocation is rechecked.

Existing atomic model-start fence remains before recall/dispatch. Two-worker, lost-response, expired-claim and revoked-authority tests demonstrate one attempt per durable review and retained will_usage_uncertain; no ambiguous retry/reset.

New method reads legacy pinned daily reflection counters only. Existing reflection reservations, policy/source hash and memory/storage paths remain unchanged; saturated person4/installation6 ledger/revision/payload hashes are preserved in real isolated PG tests.

Private callback is excluded for household reviews, which retain existing admission/shared-context guards. Original ordinary sensory route is unchanged; fresh owner alias/person/private memory scope and pre-model authority checks remain.

Authorized subscription initiative can supply capacity when legacy reflection slots are exhausted. Existing provider admission blocker, pending/running digital work gate, actual compute capacity and foreground overlap gates still prevent new quiet work where required.

Run the already-reviewed model-free fresh composition probe in both actual retained environments; require full core/worker release parity, including worker_program_sha256. Source changes must not reuse a stale release.

Keep the existing initiative mandate permission/capability list and enabled state; pin any required fresh worker_profile_release_sha256 through the same existing owner-only expected/candidate digest CAS, outside native initiative context.
Keep runtime resource-budget JSON/source hash, all legacy reflection/memory/storage ledgers and historical outcomes unchanged; do not reset usage or enlarge caps.
Read back installed exact sources, health, effective environment/mounts and actual mandate/profile binding before publishing installed status.
limitations: This is source/preparation GO, not installation or a live native self-chosen useful outcome.
Subscription predicate identifies the current route; it does not assert credit headroom or valid credentials before normal provider dispatch.
Legacy memory/reflection/storage allowances remain and are not removed or repurposed as an extra owner initiative daily cap.
Foreground priority for new quiet work is preserved; full preemption of an already-running model call is not proven.
No private delivery, full AIDE2/harness-quality, family acceptance or superiority claim.
Development credit costs and complete runtime usage remain unknown.
